description-en: On a phone held one-handed, the bottom 60% of the screen is the 'easy reach' zone. Place primary actions (CTAs, tab bars, main navigation) in the bottom half. The top 20% is a 'stretch zone' — only put secondary info there. Never place a critical CTA in the top-right corner of a portrait phone.
description-zh: 单手持机时，屏幕底部 60% 为'舒适区'。主要操作（CTA、标签栏、主导航）放在下半部。顶部 20% 为'拉伸区'——仅放次要信息。禁止将关键 CTA 放在竖屏手机右上角。
guideline: Bottom 60% = primary actions; Top 20% = secondary info only; Never CTA in top-right corner

description-en: A surface that slides up from the bottom. Two sizes: half-sheet (50% height) for quick actions, full-sheet (90% height) for forms or detail views. Drag handle: a 4px × 36px gray rounded bar at the top center. Dismiss by swiping down or tapping the scrim. Animation: spring, 300ms, translateY only.
description-zh: 从底部滑出的面板。两种尺寸：半屏 50% 高用于快捷操作，全屏 90% 高用于表单或详情。拖拽手柄：顶部居中 4px×36px 灰色圆角条。下滑或点击遮罩关闭。动画：弹性 300ms，仅 translateY。

description-en: Every interactive element — buttons, links, icons, checkboxes — must have a minimum touch target of 44×44px. Use padding to expand the hit area of small icons. Never rely on the visual size of a 16px icon alone; it's physically impossible to tap accurately. This is both an Apple HIG and Material Design requirement.
description-zh: 每个可交互元素——按钮、链接、图标、复选框——最小触控区必须 44×44px。用 padding 扩大小图标的点击区。禁止依赖 16px 图标自身大小，物理上无法准确点击。这既是 Apple HIG 也是 Material Design 要求。

description-en: Use env(safe-area-inset-*) to avoid the notch, Dynamic Island, and home indicator. Pad the top with padding-top: env(safe-area-inset-top), bottom with padding-bottom: env(safe-area-inset-bottom). For fixed bottom bars, use calc(50px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom)). Always provide a fallback value for browsers that don't support the env() function.
description-zh: 用 env(safe-area-inset-*) 避开刘海、灵动岛和 Home 指示条。顶部用 padding-top: env(safe-area-inset-top)，底部用 padding-bottom: env(safe-area-inset-bottom)。固定底栏用 calc(50px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom))。始终提供不支持 env() 的浏览器的回退值。

description-en: Mobile content flows in a single column. No side-by-side cards, no multi-column grids below 768px. Each list row: 48-56px height, a leading element (avatar/icon), title + subtitle stack, and optionally a trailing accessory (chevron/badge). Hairline separator between rows. Pull-to-refresh at top.
description-zh: 移动端内容单列流动。768px 以下禁止并排卡片、禁止多列网格。每行 48-56px 高，前导元素（头像/图标）、标题+副标题堆叠，可选尾部配件（箭头/徽记）。行间发丝线分割。顶部下拉刷新。

description-en: When the virtual keyboard appears, the focused input must remain visible. On iOS, use a KeyboardAvoidingView or scroll the form so the active field is above the keyboard. Never let the keyboard cover the submit button. On Android with 'adjustResize', the window shrinks — test both behaviors. Sticky bottom bars should hide or move above the keyboard.
description-zh: 虚拟键盘弹出时，聚焦的输入框必须保持可见。iOS 用 KeyboardAvoidingView 或上移表单使当前字段在键盘上方。禁止键盘遮住提交按钮。Android adjustResize 下窗口会收缩——两种行为都要测。粘性底栏应在键盘弹出时隐藏或上移。

name-zh: 滑动操作 — 行内动作
description-en: Swipe a list row left to reveal 1-2 action buttons (e.g., Delete, Archive). Max two actions. Destructive action in red on the far right. Swipe threshold: 60px to snap open. Spring animation to return. Never make swipe the only way to access an action — always provide a long-press or edit-mode fallback.
description-zh: 左滑列表行显示 1-2 个操作按钮（如删除、归档）。最多两个。破坏性操作在最右红底。滑动阈值 60px 吸附打开。弹性动画回弹。禁止将滑动作为操作的唯一入口——始终提供长按或编辑模式的回退方式。

description-en: On screens narrower than 480px, modals should go full-screen instead of centered. Slide up from the bottom, round only the top corners (16px), add a close button top-right or a swipe-down handle. Background: white. Never show a centered 400px dialog on a 375px screen — it feels claustrophobic and wastes space.
description-zh: 屏幕窄于 480px 时，模态应全屏而非居中弹窗。从底部滑入，仅顶部圆角 16px，右上角关闭按钮或下滑手柄。白底。禁止在 375px 屏上显示 400px 居中对话框——压抑且浪费空间。

name-zh: 暴怒连点处理 — 检测并化解
description-en: Detect rapid repeated taps (3+ taps within 800ms on the same element) — this signals user frustration. Debounce the action to prevent multiple submissions. If a button triggers a network request, disable it immediately after the first tap and show a loading state. For non-responsive buttons, ensure the tap target is at least 44px to prevent rage tapping caused by missed touches.
description-zh: 检测快速重复点击（同一元素 800ms 内 3+ 次点击）——这表示用户已经抓狂了。防抖处理防止重复提交。触发网络请求的按钮在首次点击后立即禁用并显示加载状态。对于不响应按钮，确保触控区域至少 44px 以避免因点不中导致的暴怒连击。
anti: tiny tap targets triggering rage taps

name-zh: 触觉反馈 — 触摸确认
description-en: Use short haptic vibration (10-15ms) to confirm critical irreversible actions: payment, delete, send, toggle on/off. A light tap on the screen is pure visual — haptics add a physical confirmation layer. Never use haptics on every tap (becomes annoying) or for scroll/swipe (conflicts with system). Use navigator.vibrate() on supported browsers. Always provide a visual equivalent for devices without haptics.
description-zh: 对不可逆关键操作使用短触觉振动（10-15ms）：支付、删除、发送、开关切换。屏幕轻触是纯视觉的——触觉增加了物理确认层。切忌每次点击都振（会烦死人），也不要在滚动/滑动时振动（与系统冲突）。使用 navigator.vibrate()。务必为无触觉设备提供视觉等效。

name-zh: 渐进式引导 — 揭示而非轰炸
description-en: Introduce features gradually as the user explores, not all at once on first launch. Use contextual tooltips pointing at specific UI elements when the user first encounters them. Maximum 3 onboarding tips per session. Always provide a 'Skip' or 'Got it' dismiss. The first screen should be functional immediately — not a tutorial overlay blocking the actual content.
description-zh: 功能在用户探索过程中逐步介绍，而非首次启动时全部倾泻。使用指向具体 UI 元素的情景提示，在用户首次遇到时出现。每次会话最多 3 个引导提示。始终提供「跳过」或「知道了」关闭方式。首屏应立即可用——而非一张教程遮罩盖住真正内容。
anti: first screen is tutorial, not functional

name-en: Floating Action Button — One Primary Action
name-zh: 悬浮操作按钮 — 一个主操作
description-en: A single FAB positioned at the bottom-right (16px from edges), elevated with a subtle shadow. It represents the single most important action on the current screen. Material Design standard: 56×56px. Use the brand accent color. Only one FAB per screen — never stack multiple FABs. On scroll, the FAB can hide (scroll down) and reappear (scroll up). Never let the FAB cover critical content or a bottom tab bar.
description-zh: 单个 FAB 位于右下角（距边缘 16px），微妙阴影抬高。代表当前屏幕最重要的一个操作。Material Design 标准：56×56px。使用品牌主色。每屏仅一个 FAB——禁用多个堆叠。滚动时可隐藏（向下滚）和重现（向上滚）。绝不让 FAB 盖住关键内容或底部标签栏。
anti: FAB that never hides on scroll

name-en: Infinite Scroll — Load More with End State
name-zh: 无限滚动 — 加载更多要有终点
description-en: Auto-load more content as the user scrolls near the bottom (trigger at 200-300px before the end). Always show a loading indicator during fetch. When all content is loaded, show a definitive end state: '— End of content —' or 'No more items' — never just stop loading silently (the user will keep scrolling and wonder if it's broken). Provide a 'Back to top' button after 3+ pages of scroll.
description-zh: 用户滚动接近底部时（提前 200-300px）自动加载更多。加载过程中显示指示器。所有内容加载完毕后显示明确的终点提示：'— 已经到底了 —' 或 '没有更多了'——绝不能无声地停止加载（用户会继续滚动并怀疑是否坏了）。滚动超过 3 页后提供「回到顶部」按钮。
anti: trigger too close to end causing jank

name-zh: 自适应排版 — clamp() 流体缩放
description-en: Use CSS clamp() for font sizes that scale smoothly between a minimum and maximum based on viewport width. This replaces multiple media query breakpoints for typography. Body text: clamp(1rem, 0.9rem + 0.5vw, 1.125rem). Headlines: clamp(1.5rem, 1rem + 3vw, 3rem). Always test at 320px (small phone) and 428px (large phone) to ensure readability at both extremes.
description-zh: 使用 CSS clamp() 让字体在最小值和最大值之间根据视口宽度平滑缩放，取代多断点媒体查询。正文：clamp(1rem, 0.9rem + 0.5vw, 1.125rem)。标题：clamp(1.5rem, 1rem + 3vw, 3rem)。务必在 320px（小手机）和 428px（大手机）测试，确保两极都可读。
anti: same body size for phone and desktop

name-en: Offline State — Meaningful Empty, Not Blank
name-zh: 离线状态 — 有意义的空白而非白屏
description-en: When the device is offline, show a clear, helpful state — not a blank white screen. Include: a recognizable illustration or icon (cloud with slash), a concise message ('No internet connection'), and an actionable 'Retry' button. Cache last-known-good data and show it greyed out or with a subtle 'offline' badge. Never show a raw error code or stack trace. Detect online/offline via navigator.onLine and the online/offline events.
description-zh: 设备离线时显示清晰有帮助的状态——而非白屏。包含：可辨识的图标（云朵+斜杠）、简洁文案（'网络连接已断开'）、可操作的「重试」按钮。缓存上次成功数据，灰色显示或加 '离线' 徽记。绝不显示原始错误码或堆栈跟踪。用 navigator.onLine 和 online/offline 事件检测。

description-en: A gesture that triggers content refresh when the user pulls down from the top of a scrollable list. Threshold: 60px pull distance. Visual: a circular spinner or custom animation that appears above the content, then snaps back. Haptic: a light vibration at the threshold. Never trigger refresh on horizontal scroll. Never use pull-to-refresh on pages with a sticky header that already has a refresh button. Always show a brief 'Last updated' timestamp after refresh.
description-zh: 用户从可滚动列表顶部下拉触发内容刷新。阈值：下拉 60px。视觉：内容上方出现圆形旋转器或自定义动画，然后回弹。触觉：阈值处轻振。横向滚动不触发刷新。已有刷新按钮的粘性头部页面不要用下拉刷新。刷新后显示'最后更新'时间戳。
anti: pull-to-refresh with sticky header refresh button

description-en: Mobile dark mode is not just inverting colors. Rules: background #121212 (not pure #000), elevated surfaces #1E1E1E and #232323, text rgba(255,255,255,.87) for primary and rgba(255,255,255,.60) for secondary. Reduce image brightness by 10-15% with filter: brightness(.9). Use color-mix() to generate dark variants of the accent color. Test with OLED screens — true black saves battery. Never use pure white text on pure black background — the contrast is too harsh for extended reading.
description-zh: 移动端暗色模式不只是反色。规则：背景 #121212（非纯 #000）、抬升面 #1E1E1E 和 #232323、主文本 rgba(255,255,255,.87)、次文本 rgba(255,255,255,.60)。图片亮度降低 10-15%：filter: brightness(.9)。用 color-mix() 生成主色暗色变体。OLED 屏测试——真黑省电。禁止纯白字配纯黑背景——对比度对长时间阅读太刺眼。
anti: just inverting colors with filter: invert(1)

name-zh: 骨架屏 — 移动端模式
description-en: A placeholder UI that mimics the layout of the content being loaded. On mobile: use a subtle shimmer animation (a light gradient sliding left-to-right) on gray blocks that match the expected content shapes. List items: gray avatar circle + gray text lines. Cards: gray rectangle for image + gray title line. Animation: 1.5s infinite shimmer. Show skeleton immediately on navigation, not after a timeout. Never use spinners as the only loading indicator on mobile — skeletons feel faster.
description-zh: 模拟正在加载内容布局的占位 UI。移动端：在灰色块上用微光动画（浅渐变从左到右滑动），灰色块匹配预期内容形状。列表项：灰色圆形头像+灰色文本行。卡片：灰色图片矩形+灰色标题行。动画：1.5s 无限微光。导航时立即显示骨架屏，不要等超时。移动端不要只用旋转器——骨架屏感觉更快。
anti: skeleton that doesn't match content shape
